samples.subject: Unfair grade
samples.description: Despite being present, doing activities, and submitting them on time, the instructor gave a 5.0 grade which the complainant finds unacceptable. Location: Classroom

expected.summary: The instructor gave a 5.0 grade despite the complainant completing activities and submitting on time.

samples.subject: Treated unfairly
samples.description: A faculty member from Food Technology treated me differently from others during class interactions, making me feel embarrassed. Location: Classroom

expected.summary: A faculty member treated the complainant differently during class interactions and caused embarrassment.

samples.subject: Unwanted physical contact during class

expected.summary: A classmate aggressively touched the complainant's hair during class, causing embarrassment and lowering confidence.
